title: Escultura Paisajística 3D de Máquina de Escribir Literaria de Rilke en Cuadrícula 2x2
prompt: Literary Curator & Typewriter Sculptor concept. Input: German poet Rainer Maria Rilke. Create a 2x2 grid of 'Typewriter Output as 3D Landscapes'. Each panel shows: A vintage 1920s German typewriter as the base. A single sheet of aged paper loaded in the roller. The typed German text physically rises from the page forming a 3D topographical landscape with valleys and peaks. Key lines from Rilke's 'Duino Elegies' carved into the terrain like engraved stone in Gothic script. Miniature symbolic objects from the poems placed in landscape: tiny angel figurine, rose, tower, mirror. Microscopic figurine of Rilke in 1920s attire wandering through his own words. Melancholic lighting with soft fog and golden highlights matching the contemplative emotional tone. Brass typewriter key showing 'Rilke | Duino Elegien | 1923'. Background features German romantic era items: inkwell, fountain pen, leather-bound books, dried flowers. Macro photography style with shallow depth of field, sepia and gold tones.
